parsed.justification: Both rationales correctly interpret and apply the scoring rubric, which requires every paragraph in the related work section to explicitly state the evaluated paper's contribution or its position among existing literature. Both correctly observe that only the final paragraph of the text to evaluate includes such a statement, while the first five paragraphs only summarize prior work without referencing the current paper's contribution or position. All claims made by both rationales are fully grounded in the provided evaluation material, no unsupported assumptions are introduced, and both correctly justify the conclusion that the evaluated text fails to meet the requirement.
